#!/usr/bin/env python3
import csv
import os
import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Paths
    input_path = os.path.join("outputs", "t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv")
    missingness_path = os.path.join("outputs", "t12_missingness_report.csv")
    selected_path = os.path.join("outputs", "t12_selected_matrix.csv")

    # Read the indicator matrix
    df = pd.read_csv(
        input_path,
        dtype={"city_id": str, "city_name": str, "year": int},
        keep_default_na=True,
    )

    # Indicator columns (exclude the three metadata columns)
    indicator_cols = [
        col
        for col in df.columns
        if col not in {"city_id", "city_name", "year"}
    ]

    total_rows = len(df)

    # Calculate missingness per indicator
    report_rows = []
    kept_cols = []
    for col in indicator_cols:
        missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
        missing_rate = missing_count / total_rows
        kept = missing_rate <= 0.30
        report_rows.append(
            {
                "indicator": col,
                "missing_count": missing_count,
                "missing_rate": missing_rate,
                "kept": "TRUE" if kept else "FALSE",
            }
        )
        if kept:
            kept_cols.append(col)

    # Write missingness report
    report_df = pd.DataFrame(report_rows)
    report_df.to_csv(
        missingness_path,
        index=False,
        quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL,
    )

    # Build selected matrix
    selected_cols = ["city_id", "city_name", "year"] + kept_cols
    selected_df = df[selected_cols]
    selected_df.to_csv(
        selected_path,
        index=False,
        quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL,
    )

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</solution_file>
